name: Sakado (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sakado city emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sakado, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1963.

features.role: Sakado city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character
